{{2024–25 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2024–25 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team''' represented [[Vanderbilt University]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by first-year head coach [[Mark Byington]] and played their home games at [[Memorial Gymnasium (Vanderbilt University)|Memorial Gymnasium]] located in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2023–24 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Commodores]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 9–23, 4–14 in [[2023–24 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]], to finish in 13th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2024 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2023–24 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2023-24 Vanderbilt Commodores Men's Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/vanderbilt/men/2024-schedule.html |website=Sports Reference |access-date=3 August 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=2023-24 Vanderbilt Commodores Schedule |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/teams/VANDY/vanderbilt-commodores/schedule/regular/ |website=CBS Sports |access-date=3 August 2024}}</ref>
